name: ANSI/IEEE photodiode symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for photodiode, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The photosensitive diode form associates an optical influence with a semiconductor sensing path. The optical marker is separate from electrical bias and measurement connections, which must be read from the actual sensing circuit.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Identify the measurement circuit and any bias supply.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A photodiode receives light-related input, whereas an LED is a light-emitting component.
